# Teapot API

The Teapot API lets you brew tea over HTTP. It is a small, fictional
<abbr title="Application Programming Interface">API</abbr> used only as a test
fixture for this project.

It loosely implements RFC 2324, the Hyper Text Coffee Pot Control Protocol,
except that it refuses to brew coffee and returns status 418 when asked.

## Features

- Brew black, green, and herbal tea with a single POST request.
- Query brewing status in real time.
- Strict temperature control for delicate leaves.
